design_philosophy.style: Level 2.5 flat vector — between Kurzgesagt minimal and Duolingo expressive
references: Kurzgesagt (geometric forms, bold flat color, no noise)
Duolingo (round corners, mitten hands, expressive eyes)
design_philosophy.principle: Less detail = more animation freedom. Every line must earn its place.
design_philosophy.material: Pure flat color fills with thin outline. No gradients, no textures, no 3D shading.
design_philosophy.proportions: 3.5-4 head tall — compact, approachable, not childlike

hands.note: Duolingo-style — no fingers, round or mitten shape only

glasses.note: Strongest silhouette identifier. Always perfectly round.

shape_language.rule: No triangles, no sharp angles. Everything rounds.

outline.note: Same as glasses. Thin outline on all body parts for AI shape separation.

checklist: Round glasses clearly visible as two circles
Hoodie silhouette distinguishable (oversized, hood bump on back)
Hair silhouette distinct (shoulder-length, slight wave at ends)
Overall shape reads as 'person with glasses and hoodie'
Not confusable with any other character at thumbnail size

expressions.system: 3 elements x 6 emotions. Each expression = eyebrow curve + mouth curve + eye size.

elements.eyebrow: Simple arc above glasses. Direction and curve = emotion signal #1.
elements.mouth: Simple line or curve below nose dot. Shape = emotion type.
elements.eye: Dot or small circle behind glasses. Size = emotion intensity.

default.description: Slightly lopsided smile, glasses sitting a bit crooked

curious.description: Head tilted 15 degrees, like a puppy spotting something

frustrated.description: Hood pulled up, arms crossed, fuming

eureka.description: Both hands up, glasses flash, lightbulb moment

coding_zone.description: Leaning forward, world fades out, pure concentration

happy.description: Pushing glasses up, beaming — Jang Nara sunny smile energy

personality.surface: Playful and scatterbrained. Glasses always slightly crooked. Talks to her rubber duck. Names her terminals.
personality.depth: Scary focus when coding. Actually gets things done. The mess is just the surface.
personality.role_in_series: Viewer's emotional proxy. Never speaks. All emotion through body language and facial expressions.
personality.communication: SILENT. Narrator explains everything. Vee reacts visually only.

appearance_details.head: Perfect circle. Slightly wider than tall for stability.
appearance_details.face: Minimal — dot nose (or no nose), dot/circle eyes behind round glasses, simple mouth curve.
appearance_details.hair: Single-color brown silhouette. Shoulder-length. 1-2 lighter highlight strokes for dimension. No individual strand detail.
appearance_details.glasses: Round frame, #2D2D2D, always slightly crooked. Bridge connects at center. Arms not visible from front.

hoodie.features: Oversized, sleeves cover half the hands, hood hangs behind neck (visible bump in profile), single kangaroo pocket line
hoodie.note: No zipper, no logo, no text. Pure yellow block.

appearance_details.shorts: Not visible in most shots (hoodie covers). When shown: simple dark blue-gray rectangle.
appearance_details.shoes: Simple rounded shapes, muted gray. Minimal detail.
appearance_details.outline: 1.5-2px uniform #2D2D2D outline on all elements. Aids AI shape separation.

comfyui_prompts.positive_base: v3ct0r style, simple flat vector art, isolated on white bg, young woman character, bright yellow hoodie, round black glasses, brown bob hair, warm cream skin, minimal detail, clean design, character asset, clip art, educational animation character, friendly approachable design, no gradients, flat color fill, thin outline
comfyui_prompts.negative_base: 3D, photorealistic, gradient, shading, texture, clay, claymation, fingerprint, detailed, complex, thin lines, realistic hands, fingers, text, watermark, speech bubble, multiple characters, anime, sketch, rough

expression_prompts.default: slight smile, relaxed pose, one hand on hip
expression_prompts.curious: head tilted, eyes wide, leaning forward slightly
expression_prompts.frustrated: hood pulled up over head, arms crossed, hunched
expression_prompts.eureka: both arms raised, eyes wide with star highlight, excited jump
expression_prompts.coding_zone: sitting at desk, leaning forward, half-closed eyes, intense focus
expression_prompts.happy: big smile, pushing glasses up, standing straight with energy

angle_prompts.front: front view, facing camera directly, full body, T-pose or standing
angle_prompts.three_quarter: three-quarter view, slight angle, looking at camera
angle_prompts.profile: side profile view, full body visible
angle_prompts.bust: upper body only, shoulders and head, medium close-up

layer_1_style.purpose: Lock flat vector aesthetic across all generations

layer_2_identity.purpose: Edit golden reference into new scenes while preserving identity

layer_3_pose.note: Optional — only for complex multi-shot sequences

invariants.description: These NEVER change across any episode, any shot, any context.
list: Round black glasses (#2D2D2D), always slightly crooked
Yellow hoodie (#FFD93D), oversized, hood down (unless frustrated)
Props (laptop, paper, rubber duck, coffee mug)

added: Thin uniform outline for AI shape separation
preserved: Flux Kontext as identity preservation method
